caseName: Florida ex rel. McKeighan v. Sullivan
caseNameFull: Florida ex rel. McKeighan v. Sullivan, Sheriff
attorneys: Neville Miller for appellant., Eugene F. Black, Attorney General of Michigan, and J. Velma Keen for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the reason that the judgment of the court below is based upon a nonfederal ground adequate to support it. Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
